ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $5.00 no-show fee; no refund and no account action against either party on this record.
ruling.reasoning:
Both sides agree, and the record confirms, that the driver cancelled because the rider did not appear: his app reason is blank (F4) and his own words are "Waited 5 min already, you never come, cancelling" (F12) and "The rider did not come, so I cancelled" (F15). No personal, vehicle or job reason appears in his words, so the NS-0 element reads "met" and the case is governed by NS-1 (NS-0, NS-1).

NS-1(i) is met on the record: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 18:17:45, 40 m from the pickup point (F7), which is inside the 200 m radius NS-1(i) requires, and his closest approach was 21 m (F1). The algorithm counts the arrival within 200 m as a pass, and the fact the driver recorded 40 m off the door does not defeat it — the radius, not the curb, is the test (NS-1).

NS-1(ii) is met: the driver remained stationary at the pickup area from 18:17:45 until he cancelled at 18:23:25, i.e. 5 min 40 s, counted from the later of arrival and scheduled pickup time, so the 5-minute free wait had run (F3, F6, F7). The trip began when the driver accepted at 18:15:00 (F4), and his "5 min already" message at 18:23 is consistent with that clock (F12): 18:17:45 + 5:00 = 18:22:45, cancelled 18:23:25 (NS-1).

NS-1(iii) is met: before cancelling the driver sent 3 timestamped in-app messages, the first at 18:18:15, and made one in-app call at 18:19:15 (F5, F10, F13, F14). NS-1(iv) is met: he held position within 200 m continuously for the whole wait (F2, F3, F7) and the trace's continuity check passes; there is no GPS hole to leave presence unproven (NS-1).

With all four NS-1 conditions holding, the $5.00 fee on record (F4, F8) stands and NS-2's voiding rule is not triggered; the amount in issue is the fixed fee on record, and no distance or surge arithmetic applies (NS-1, NS-2). The trace settles NS-9 as a fail — no prior no-show(s) in 30 days — so there is no flag_account here (NS-9).

The rider's fraud flag for frequent late cancellations (F19) only raises the confidence threshold; it does not decide the fee, and the fee here rests on the GPS, timeline and chat record, not on the profile, so the profile is not used as a reason (TH-3).
